description: This file contains test functions for the 'Merge' utility, focusing on merging complex nested structs, maps, slices, and pointers within the Mattermost server codebase. It includes setup functions, test cases for various merge scenarios, and helper functions to invoke the merge operations.

methods.name: mergeSimple
methods.description: Helper function to merge two 'simple' structs using utils.Merge and return the result.

methods.description: Helper function to merge two 'evenSimpler' structs using utils.Merge.

methods.name: mergeEvenSimplerWithConfig
methods.description: Helper function to merge 'evenSimpler' structs with custom merge configuration.
